datasets.name: ReserveData
datasets.sql:
select
h.id ,
LoanAcc.Acc_No ,
LoanAcc.Bal_Cn1 ,
LoanAcc.Val_Acc ,
Round(h.PRIMARYDEBTREST  * op.Ostat , 2) as Rest,
sbcm_stored_programs.GetReservePercentByID(h.PRIMARYRESERVEPERCENT) as ReservePercent ,
c.OpenDate ,
c.CloseDate ,
cat.truecategory
from
sbcm_state_history h ,
sbcm_contracts c,
sbcm_contract_accounts a,
operkurs op ,
Account LoanAcc ,
sbcm_categories cat 

where
  h.PRIMARYDEBTREST > 0 and
  h.HDate = :HDate and
  h.id# = c.id and
  c.id = a.id# and
  op.dat = :HDate and
  op.val_kod = LoanAcc.val_acc and
  c.ClientType = cat.id and  
  LoanAcc.ID = a.ContractAccID

union

select
h.id ,
LoanAcc.Acc_No ,
LoanAcc.Bal_Cn1 ,
LoanAcc.Val_Acc ,
Round(h.OVERDUEDEBTREST * op.Ostat , 2) as Rest ,
sbcm_stored_programs.GetReservePercentByID(h.OVERDUERESERVEPERCENT) as ReservePercent ,
c.OpenDate ,
c.CloseDate ,
cat.truecategory
from
sbcm_state_history h ,
sbcm_contracts c,
sbcm_contract_accounts a,
operkurs op ,
sbcm_categories cat ,
Account LoanAcc

where
  h.OverdueDebtRest > 0 and
  h.HDate = :HDate and
  h.id# = c.id and
  c.id = a.id# and
  op.dat = :HDate and 
  op.val_kod = LoanAcc.val_acc and
  c.ClientType = cat.id and
  LoanAcc.ID = a.OverdueAccID
